description: This file defines the ChiSquared class with methods for chi-squared distribution calculations, including tail probabilities, inverse functions, and chi-square tests, used in statistical calculations within PhpSpreadsheet.

classes.name: ChiSquared
classes.description: Provides statistical functions related to chi-squared distribution, including tail probabilities, inverse calculations, and chi-square tests.

methods.name: distributionRightTail
methods.description: Calculates the one-tailed probability of the chi-squared distribution for a given value and degrees of freedom.

methods.name: distributionLeftTail
methods.description: Calculates the left tail probability or the probability density function of the chi-squared distribution based on the 'cumulative' boolean.

methods.name: inverseRightTail
methods.description: Calculates the inverse of the right-tailed probability for a given probability and degrees of freedom.

methods.name: inverseLeftTail
methods.description: Calculates the inverse of the left-tailed probability for a given probability and degrees of freedom.

methods.name: test
methods.description: Performs a chi-square test comparing observed and expected frequencies, returning the p-value.
